summary: The session debates the future of business intelligence (BI) in the context of artificial intelligence (AI), with Julian advocating for AI's transformative potential while Carly emphasizes the enduring value of BI. Both speakers agree that AI and BI can coexist and enhance each other, rather than one replacing the other. The discussion highlights the importance of governance, accountability, and the need for a balanced approach to analytics in organizations.

key_points: Introduction of the debate question regarding AI and BI
Julian's belief that AI will replace BI
Carly argues that AI will enhance rather than replace BI
Discussion of the evolution from Hadoop to Data Lakes
Discussion on who owns analytic authority
Importance of governance in BI and AI

sections.topic: Cost and Value of AI vs BI
key_points: Debate on the cost-effectiveness of AI compared to BI
Concerns about AI insights potentially being more costly
Need for a semantic layer to avoid chaos in insights
Final thoughts on the coexistence of AI and BI

key_takeaways: AI and BI should work together to enhance analytics capabilities.
Governance is crucial in ensuring accountability and trust in analytics.
Organizations should document their analytics processes to leverage AI effectively.
